title: Thai Customs seize over 3,000 vapes and Kpods worth $89,000

blocks.text: BANGKOK – Thai Customs officials have seized more than 3,000 electronic cigarettes and Kpods, valued at nearly 3 million baht ($89,000), in a joint operation aimed at preventing the illegal products from reaching young people in three north-eastern provinces. The seizure was announced on Oct 31 by Chong Chom Customs House, which oversees Customs enforcement
